internal_acceptance.note: The matching Stack Overflow suite was selected and the application started. The implementation and repair trace did not converge before final Playwright execution.

confirmed_causes: Seven implementation turns reached the approximately 900-second Octos turn cap.
Repair turns repeatedly hit the request budget of 10, leaving claims unverified; the two full-suite repairs ended without a confirmed file edit and validation cycle.
One full-suite repair prompt explicitly omitted or truncated the remaining failure files, preventing the next edit cycle.
not_evidenced: No cgroup OOM kill was recorded.
No global time-budget exhaustion was recorded.
The final test failures cannot be attributed to a single code root cause from the supplied logs alone; Phase 4 must inspect the template against the six failing specs.

metering.note: Platform token count and provider totals are different accounting scopes and are not added together.

official_tests.value: final Playwright report with 66 requirement-derived specs

conclusions.primary_confirmed_execution_issue: Seven implementation turns hit the 900-second turn cap; two separate upstream proxy_error events affected REQ-2.5.1 repair and REQ-2.5.2 implementation.
conclusions.primary_confirmed_runner_issue: The runner reached the matching public test suite, but request-budget guards and truncated repair context prevented a verified convergent repair; runner completion is not a passing result.
conclusions.primary_confirmed_platform_symptom: The final suite produced six Playwright timeouts concentrated in profile editing, answer editing/deletion, custom filters, badge notification and responses/comments.
conclusions.implementation_root_cause_status: Exact final-template code causes remain Phase 4 read-only diagnosis work; Phase 3 does not infer DOM or data bugs from timeout symptoms alone.
conclusions.summary_discrepancy: The human summary says eight implementation failures were seven timeouts plus a REQ-2.5.1 proxy_error. Raw stdout and runner events instead show seven implementation timeouts, a REQ-2.5.1 repair proxy_error, and a REQ-2.5.2 implementation proxy_error; REQ-2.5.1 and REQ-2.5.2 both passed final official tests.

optimization_candidates.action: Keep the run-specific Stack Overflow suite identity explicit and fail closed when /workspace/tests has no specs; preserve the verified selected suite path in the execution contract.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents hidden test-discovery drift while retaining the correct suite routing evidenced in this run.

optimization_candidates.action: Replace broad per-node exploration with a bounded inspect -> minimal patch -> targeted spec -> build/start/smoke loop, and stop after repeated request-budget or protected-file guards.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces 900-second turn timeouts, unverified writes and repair non-convergence.

optimization_candidates.action: Make repair prompts carry complete failure files and cap repair scope to the current failing cluster; do not declare completion before the promised build, start and request checks run.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents the full-suite repair from ending with omitted/truncated context and no confirmed file edits.

optimization_candidates.action: Add bounded retry/backoff for transient provider HTTP/2 proxy_error and preserve the node state for a later retry instead of spending the remaining repair budget on a blind rewrite.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Limits the impact of the two upstream connection failures without conflating them with application defects.

optimization_candidates.action: Use workers=1 for the final clean-seed smoke and isolate process cleanup per turn; investigate the 465 postflight reaped processes separately.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Improves determinism and run hygiene; the supplied logs do not prove process accumulation caused the six final failures.
